text:
sam: Noticing a parity gap: ruby-sdk retries on 429 by default but doesn't treat 500 as retryable, while js/go SDKs treat 500 as retryable for idempotent requests. Causing more user-reported transient failures.

rao: That's intentional historically because we saw a few customer ops where 500 masked auth errors. But maybe we can make it configurable and align defaults.

lina: Do we have telemetry that shows which status codes are most common for transient errors? I can pull last 30d from observability.

ci-bot: query job #221 started for metrics/ingest/transient_errors (30d).

patrick: For SDK parity my vote is: default retry on 429, 502, 503, 504, 500 but only for idempotent methods (GET/HEAD/embeddings). Non-idempotent (create/completion) keep conservative defaults. Also add an env var override `REDWOOD_RUBY_RETRY_STRATEGY`.

sam: I like that. For completions we can expose a per-call option `retry: :none|:idempotent|:all` in the client initializer. Keep default conservative.

rao: Implementation detail: our current retry middleware only inspects exceptions, not http status. We'll need to upgrade to a response-aware middleware and add tests. Minimal PR should: 1) add status code handling, 2) wire in config flag, 3) unit tests for 429/500 behavior. No CLI changes.

lina: Metrics job finished: 30d window shows 429s are ~0.6% of calls, 500-504 combined ~0.15%. Most 500s cluster around a single customer endpoint that hit a model OOM. So retrying 500 might help but could amplify load. Maybe backoff policy should be slightly more aggressive for 429 vs 500.

patrick: Good point. Let's implement exponential backoff with jitter and different max attempts for each class: 429 -> max_attempts 4, 5xx -> max_attempts 2. Document rationale in CHANGELOG and SDK README.

sam: Can someone open a small PR that changes middleware and adds the config flag? Keep behavior behind a minor-version toggle: default to old behavior unless `enable_response_retries: true` set in client options. Then we can flip after a week of canary.

rao: I'll draft the PR. Also add an integration test in CI that uses a test server to emit 500 then 200 to ensure the client retries.

lina: Quick note about telemetry: when this rolls out, please emit metric `sdk.retry.triggered` with tags code=500/429 and attempts count so we can monitor.

patrick: Tiny nit for PR review: keep names consistent with other SDKs (`max_retries` vs `max_attempts`) — we use `max_retries` everywhere else.

rao: Good catch, will use `max_retries`. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/ruby-sdk/pull/342 - adds response-aware retry middleware, config flag `enable_response_retries`, and tests + CI job. PTAL @sam @lina.

sam: Reviewing now. Quick comment: update docs snippet in README to show per-call `client.completions.create(retry: :none)` example.

lina: Also include the telemetry instrumentation in the PR so we can validate in staging.

ci-bot: CI run #444 started for PR 342.

patrick: If CI passes, let's roll to canary for a day with `enable_response_retries: true` in the ruby-canary stack only. Monitor `sdk.retry.triggered` and error-rate.

sam: Agreed. After canary we'll decide default change. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

rao: Thanks. Will follow up with PR updates based on reviews.

ci-bot: CI run #444 passed
